admission.justification: Both fixer/index public writes and mechanical refresh must preserve authority and refused bytes; a bypass could corrupt a root that leaves depend on.

applicability: Contractless citation_fix / memory-citations --fix and route_index_refresh apply on a declared converted external memory root before attributed adoption.
conditions: Declared repository and exact declared/resolved root, layout marker, no attributed baseline, no linked worktree; unreadable worktree listing fails closed.
Both admissions compose the existing writer; refusal preserves a refused card and its sidecar.
exclusions: Caller-asserted bypass flags, a fabricated leaf, commits or knowledge-record writes.
Contractless writes after attribution or when a leaf may depend on the root.
Contractless migration, index-build and citation-check CLI modes.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_bootstrap_converted_onboarding.py (five admission conditions one by one, pre-baseline authoring with sidecars, post-baseline refusals for fixer and route-index, refused-reauthor byte-identical regression); mcp/tests/test_tool_entry_point_controls.py (optional contract_path pin, 17 passed); journey45.py + run-cli-probes.txt (admit rc=0, refuse rc=1)

statement: The existing fixer runs before the first baseline under one measured admission (declared repo, declared root, layout marker, no adopted baseline, no linked worktrees) and answers admission pre-baseline; every other uncontracted call refuses naming the leaf route.
